title: 耳鳴りの底、泥に眠る言葉
author: 朽木 灯

prediction.question: 石板の叫びを聞いた湊の次に起こる出来事は？
options: 志乃が湊を抱き寄せ、耳を塞ぐ
石板から湊の名前を呼ぶ声が響く
柳が恐怖に震えながら湊を突き飛ばす

en.title: Beneath the Tinnitus, Words Slumber in the Mud
en.premise: Following the death of a distant relative, the protagonist is called back to a village where the rain never ceases. The will left behind contains a cryptic condition: they must manage a "library" located in the basement of the estate. It is not a place for books, but a repository of stone tablets, each sealing the "final whispers" of the deceased. Just as they begin to grow accustomed to the silence, the protagonist realizes that a whisper from someone unknown is echoing deep within their ears.

zh.title: 耳鸣深处，泥中沉睡之语
zh.premise: 因疏远的亲属去世，主人公被召回了一个连绵阴雨不断的村庄。留下的遗嘱中写着一个不可思议的条件：管理位于宅邸地下的“图书馆”。那里存放的并非书籍，而是排列着封存了死者“临终呢喃”的石板。就在逐渐习惯这份寂静之时，主人公察觉到，在耳畔深处，正回响着某个素未谋面之人的低语。
